owners.description: Casting Intro Skill Immediate Execution gives 12% Spectro DMG Bonus for 14s.

owners.label: Fear No Pain
owners.description: When in Ready Stance, all DMG taken is reduced by 40%.

owners.label: Beacon For the Future
owners.description: Attack the target, dealing Spectro DMG equal to 150% of Zani's ATK and removing all stacks of Heliacal Ember inflicted upon the target. Each stack increases the DMG dealt by 10%. This DMG is considered Spectro Frazzle DMG. The Spectro DMG dealt by other Resonators in the team to the target marked by Heliacal Ember is Amplified by 20% for 20s.

owners.label: When the Alarm Clock Rings
owners.description:
Casting Targeted Action or Forcible Riposte gives a 50% Spectro DMG Bonus for 14s.
Resonance Skill Heavy Slash - Nightfall can't be interrupted.

owners.label: Stale Bread With Energy Drink
owners.description:
Crit. Rate is increased by 20%.
The DMG Multiplier of Targeted Action and Forcible Riposte is increased by 80%.

owners.label: Each Day A New Commute
owners.description: When in Inferno Mode, every 1 Blazes consumed increases the last stage DMG Multiplier of the subsequent Resonance Liberation The Last Stand by 8%, maxed at 1200%.

owners.label: More Efficiency, Less Drama
owners.description: When Intro Skill Immediate Execution is cast, the ATK of all Resonators in the team is increased by 20% for 30s.

owners.label: Delivered In Full On Time
owners.description: The DMG Multiplier of Resonance Liberation Rekindle is increased by 120%.

owners.label: First Things First? Clock Out!
owners.description:
The DMG Multipliers of Heavy Slash - Daybreak, Heavy Slash- Dawning, Heavy Slash - Nightfall, and Heavy Slash - Lightsmash are increased by 40%. Every Blaze consumed increases the DMG Multiplier of Heavy Slash - Nightfall by 40% on hit.
Gain following effects when in Inferno Mode:
- When Blaze is lower than 70, restore 70 Blazes immediately. This effect is triggered once in Inferno Mode.
- Within 8s after entering Inferno Mode, Zani will remain standing with at least 1 HP if hit by a fatal blow.
